course_name_original: ATA1031 — Atatürk İlkeleri ve İnkılâp Tarihi 1
course_name_en: Atatürk's Principles and History of Revolutions 1

learning_outcomes.text: Students will learn the meaning and benefit of historical research.
Students will learn the pre-modernization Ottoman history in general terms.
Students will be able to evaluate the modernization process within European history and compare it with Ottoman history.
Students will be able to evaluate 19th-century Ottoman history in the context of modernization efforts.
Students will be able to understand and evaluate the present day in relation to the history of the Ottoman Empire and the Republic of Turkey.

syllabus_topics: Introduction: Possibilities and limits of history: basic concepts
Ottoman state and social structure before modernization efforts, 16th to 18th Centuries
Transformations in Ottoman state and social structure before modernization efforts, 18th century
Meaning of modernization and Formation of the Modern State / Beginning of modernization efforts in the Ottoman state: At the beginning of the Long 19th Century
Tanzimat period (1839-1876): restructuring of the central state
II. Constitutional Monarchy period: Pluralism in the public sphere
II. Constitutional Monarchy period: Pluralism in the public sphere
World War I: "Total" war and the rise of nationalism
General Social and Political Situation in the World and the Ottoman State After World War I
War of Independence I: Political Developments
War of Independence II: Military Developments
Formation and Content of the Treaty of Lausanne
